fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-html) carry headline/articleBody-style fields extracted from ld+json NewsArticle plus the #Content HTML body; latest-mode records (S2-html-listing) carry title/link/urlDate, scraped from the homepage (day-precision date only, derived from the URL path).

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-html, S2-html-listing).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description -- absent on wire-service/video-type content with no named byline.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, joined from

tags inside the #Content element (stable id across multiple CMS template generations). Only page 1 is captured for paginated photo-essay articles.

author.title: Author
author.description: Author name, extracted from the ld+json author object's 'name' field when present (absent on wire-service/video-type content).

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher name, extracted from the ld+json publisher object's 'name' field -- inconsistently either 'China Daily' or 'chinadaily.com.cn' depending on which CMS template rendered the page, passed through raw (not normalized).

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image value as emitted by upstream ld+json (raw passthrough, shape varies).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text scraped from the homepage link (latest mode) -- the longest non-empty anchor text seen for that URL.

urlDate.title: URL date
urlDate.description: Day-precision date (YYYY-MM-DD) derived from the article URL path, not a true publish timestamp (latest mode only). Fetch the article for the exact datePublished.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
